title: ModelRegistry
description: ArchResidenceBD model registry v0.1.0 (plan §5 fixed model roster; spike S2) - the fleet manifest: which models the product ships, in which role, pinned by artifact sha256. Consumed by the installer/downloader (P1), the W0.8 model cards and the Licences screen. displayName is the only user-facing string; upstream/runtime naming is internal provenance shown (if at all) behind the Licences screen per ADR-0004. Real instance: spec/models/registry.json.

fleetId.description: Fleet generation id, e.g. 'archie-fleet-v1' (S2 froze fleet v1).

notes.description: Fleet-level notes (e.g. deliberate exclusions - never silent).

role.description: Fleet role v0 (S2 roster). One entry per role in the shipped fleet.

displayName.description: The only user-facing string. Never an upstream model name (ADR-0004).

swapGroup.description: S2 policy groups: gpu-models swap exclusively (one resident in VRAM at a time); cpu-services stay persistent and are pinned to CPU (gpuLayers 0).

distribution.description: bundled = ships inside the one installer (P1 plan); downloadable = fetched from the registry's HF source on demand; candidate = evaluated, not shipped; training = placeholder awaiting a fine-tune.

repo.description: Upstream repository id, e.g. 'Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507'. Internal provenance.

license.description: SPDX license id of the upstream weights, e.g. 'Apache-2.0'. Feeds the Licences screen notices.

revision.description: Upstream revision/commit the artifact was built from, when known.

file.description: File name inside the models directory, e.g. 'Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-Q4_K_M.gguf'.

engine.description: In-app runner (no external runtime such as Ollama/LM Studio). Internal provenance; MIT-licensed, listed on the Licences screen.

gpuLayers.description: Layers offloaded to GPU. S2: 99 for GPU rows; CPU rows MUST be pinned to 0 - llama.cpp auto-fit otherwise pulls embed/rerank into VRAM and crowds the chat model out on the 6 GB floor.

flags.description: Extra server flags beyond the standard envelope, e.g. ['--no-webui'].
